findings.description: cachekey appends `"\n*"` when the upstream sent no `Vary`, and cacheget at line 83 tries the vary key then the wildcard. The no-Vary gzip entry is therefore served to identity and no-header clients without re-calling the upstream.
findings.title: A Vary-less response is keyed as `\n*` and tried before the encoding key, so gzip reaches identity clients

limitations: All RCE is RCE on the upstream host
Needs a cache-enabled config and an upstream that sends Cache-Control: public, max-age=
